actual_scope: Implement one complete Gaussian monomial with encoded tensor-phase controls, signed fixed-width component traversal, compiled affine gates, arbitrary complete outer rows and one reusable physical Compact inventory.

I implement the distinct encoded fixed-role phase/monomial boundary and retain their credit.

stop_rule: Require exact signed-pair semantics with phase-specific overflow rejection, encoded repeated phases, complete forward/inverse Gaussian packets, source/semantic/ownership controls, preserved borrowed inputs and a complete cost invoice. Stop at a failed source contract or charge.
evidence: I passed all eight registered cold commands on Python 3.12.13/macOS arm64 at 23:04 UTC on October16,2026: 1344 signed pairs, 580 encoded phase cases, complete generic and selected packets, a complete 2048-record spaced rectangle, later-field signed rejection and reuse, an unused 4097-digit G descriptor, and eight injected failures. Arithmetic and failure controls also passed with assertions disabled. PROOF.md states the quantified source-relative refinement and cost bound. I claim no hosted CI, independent human or formal-refinement pass.
